name: Silves
mandate: PrompTugal.news Silves: AI and technology in Silves, the Algarve's orange capital and old regional capital, and what reaches Silves from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Silves is a large, mostly rural municipality of six parishes and about 680 square kilometres, known as the orange capital of the Algarve and as the old capital of the Kingdom of the Algarve. Citrus is its signature crop: in November 2026 the Algarve citrus operators' association said Silves holds 43 percent of the area of the region's protected-origin (IGP) citrus, which covers 4,733 hectares and 419 farms. The council says its business life rests on industrial platforms in Algoz, Alcantarilha and São Bartolomeu de Messines, and it runs a local entrepreneurship office, GEL.

ai_news.title: Silves council and Turismo de Portugal run a free advanced AI-for-business course
ai_news.summary: Silves's Formação + Próxima programme, a partnership of the council, Turismo de Portugal and the Portimão hotel and tourism school, held an advanced course called AI at the service of business at the municipal library on 26 and 27 March 2026. It was free, certified and open to tourism professionals and companies, with registration through Turismo de Portugal's digital academy.
ai_news.ai_path: The course teaches AI directly, and the Silves council hosts it for local businesses.

ai_news.title: AI and robots for citrus: the ATTENTIA project, with the University of Algarve
ai_news.summary: ATTENTIA, a cross-border Interreg project, applies AI and robotics to citrus crop management in Andalusia and the Algarve-Alentejo area. It is led by the University of Huelva with the University of Algarve and the University of Seville, and runs from 1 September 2023 to 31 December 2026. The project sheet does not name Silves.
ai_news.ai_path: Silves is the Algarve's orange capital, and this project builds AI methods for Algarve citrus orchards. It is the nearest AI project to Silves's main crop, but the sheet does not say any of the work is in Silves.

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Silves
ai_map.what: The municipal council. It co-hosts the free Formação + Próxima training for the local tourism sector, which included an advanced AI-for-business course in March 2026, and it runs the GEL entrepreneurship office.
ai_map.ai_path: It hosts AI training for local businesses.

extras.label: Fully digital master plan
extras.value: The council says Silves was the first in the Algarve with a second-generation, fully digital municipal master plan (PDM), in force since 12 January 2021, with a new revision being prepared. This is digital, not AI.

extras.label: Coworking
extras.value: The council says it opened coworking spaces in São Marcos da Serra and São Bartolomeu de Messines at the end of 2021. A 2025 opinion column said Silves was one of four Algarve municipalities with no incubator, business centre, accelerator or coworking space, citing AMAL.

extras.label: Membership of AMAL
extras.value: Silves is one of the 16 municipalities listed by AMAL, whose digital programmes include AlgarveMaisDigital and Região Inteligente Algarve. AMAL's page does not say whether Silves takes part in them.

extras.label: Digital funding calls on the council's page
extras.value: The council's calls page lists national digital-transition funding for businesses, such as Smart PME (Industry 4.0), Coaching 4.0 and vouchers for startups with green and digital products. The titles name no AI, and the page gives no dates, so we treat this as context, not AI.

gaps: We found no AI company, startup or research group based in Silves in public sources. The AI map holds only the council, and that is a finding, not an oversight.

We found no AI event in Silves with a date still ahead on the council's agenda (read 15 November 2026, first page only: nothing on 16 or 20 November). A search snippet mentions a Silves AI-for-SMEs session on those dates, but we could not open its page and Barlavento's own search did not show it, so we do not list it until an open source confirms it.

The council's own pages show no AI, smart-city or data project. Its projects and studies page lists twelve items, none digital, and its news page has no RSS link, so the council cannot be followed automatically yet.

Leads we checked and left out because they fail the PrompTugal test: the Fábrica do Inglês revival is a property and heritage project, and the Silves irrigation perimeter works are about piping and water loss, with no AI in what we could read. We will revisit both if a source ties either to AI.
Postal do Algarve, Terra Ruiva, RUA FM, Região Sul and Agroportal returned bot challenges or refusals, so we did not read them. Barlavento and Sul Informação load and have feeds.

The current citrus figure is a share of the protected-origin (IGP) area, from the operators' association via Barlavento. We found no 2026 count of all citrus hectares or farms in Silves, and no source on digital or AI use on its farms: the article names mechanisation as a priority and mentions nothing digital.

Sources to look for next: the producers' association AlgarOrange for any AI or digital pilots, the companies on the industrial platforms of Algoz, Alcantarilha and São Bartolomeu de Messines, and the Plataforma Logística de Tunes.

voice.lede: Eh pá, Silves: a capital of the Algarve before it was cool, still guarding its laranjas from a castle the colour of a ripe tangerine.

voice.gravity: Silves is a big, mostly countryside concelho with six freguesias and about 680 square kilometres, the laranja capital of the Algarve and the old capital of its Kingdom, so it never lets you forget it. Oranges are the star: in November 2026 the citrus operators' association said Silves holds 43 percent of the area of the region's protected-origin IGP citrus, some 4,733 hectares and 419 farms. The câmara says business lives in the industrial platforms of Algoz, Alcantarilha and São Bartolomeu de Messines, with the GEL office to help.
voice.gaps_intro: Now the honest part, meu amigo: where the algorithms have not yet come to the orange grove.
